name: Enterprise B2B Multi-Tenant Identity & Fine-Grained Authorization Platform
objective: Design an enterprise-grade multi-tenant identity, fine-grained access control (ReBAC / Zanzibar), and data isolation architecture supporting 50,000 corporate organizations with strict compliance requirements (HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, FedRAMP).
constraints: Strict tenant data isolation preventing cross-tenant data contamination via PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) and cryptographic tenant keys
Sub-10ms authorization policy evaluation latency for fine-grained resource permission checks at 50,000 checks/sec
Seamless enterprise SAML 2.0 / OIDC SSO federation with automated SCIM 2.0 user lifecycle provisioning
Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK / BYOK) envelope encryption using AWS KMS / HashiCorp Vault
Tamper-proof, cryptographically signed audit logging streamed to customer SIEMs (Splunk, Datadog, AWS S3)

components.name: Enterprise Identity & SSO Federation Broker
components.responsibility: Orchestrates SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect authentication handshakes with corporate identity providers (Okta, Azure AD, Ping Identity, Google Workspace).

components.name: Relationship-Based Access Control (ReBAC) Engine
components.technology: OpenFGA / SpiceDB (Google Zanzibar Architecture) on CockroachDB
components.responsibility: Evaluates hierarchical authorization tuples (e.g. user:alice is editor of document:doc1 because she is member of organization:org1) with sub-10ms latency.

components.name: Multi-Tenant Relational Storage with RLS
components.technology: PostgreSQL 16 with Citus Sharding & Row-Level Security
components.responsibility: Guarantees cryptographic and logical database separation per tenant, enforcing session variables (SET app.current_tenant_id) on all SQL connections.

components.name: CMEK / BYOK Envelope Encryption Coordinator
components.technology: HashiCorp Vault / AWS KMS Transit Engine
components.responsibility: Generates and wraps per-tenant Data Encryption Keys (DEKs) using corporate Key Encryption Keys (KEKs), enabling instantaneous tenant data shredding.
interfaces: Vault REST API / AWS KMS SDK

components.name: Immutable SIEM Audit Log Shipper
components.technology: Apache Kafka / AWS Kinesis Firehose / ClickHouse
components.responsibility: Emits append-only, SHA-256 chained security audit logs to customer SIEM destinations for real-time compliance alerting.

security_threats: SPOOFING: SAML assertion replay attack bypassing tenant SSO authentication
INFORMATION_DISCLOSURE: Leaked tenant ID in multi-tenant API route causing Cross-Tenant Data Access (BOLA / IDOR)
ELEVATION_OF_PRIVILEGE: Malicious user exploiting circular role hierarchy to grant themselves super-admin privileges
